I've replied to Pree in the DM: her cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is 21 October. That's what she told me in this DM on 14 October, and I read the DM back to check it.

When I read back, I found a mistake from 14 October. The summary of my reply, which was meant for you, had been posted into Pree's DM as a second message. It didn't contain anything she hadn't already seen, but I apologised for it in my reply to her.
